title: oncoba ngounyensis
intro: Oncoba ngounyensis, commonly known as the Oncoba tree, is a plant species in the family Salicaceae. This plant is traditionally used in African medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Oncoba ngounyensis are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
